what: crates/blaze-alloc-count: on an assert_at_most failure, print where each counted allocation came from (capture a std::backtrace::Backtrace per allocation inside the measured closure, only when BLAZE_ALLOC_TRACE=1 is set, with a reentrancy guard so the capture itself is not counted), so allocation-budget failures can be fixed from the coordinator s logs by lanes that may not run cargo. First user: 01146, blaze-query tests::a_warm_miss_allocates_at_most_a_segment (3 allocations, 8225 bytes = segment + 32 + 1, budget 1; not findable by reading: I traced the miss path, file read, Bytes clone and value buffers, all allocation-free). Then please run that test with BLAZE_ALLOC_TRACE=1 and send query-unify the trace.

history.note: BLAZE_ALLOC_TRACE=1 in blaze-alloc-count: each counted allocation keeps its size and a backtrace (an OWN guard keeps the capture and the trace list out of the count), and a failing assert_at_most prints every one; without it the failure says how to trace. Tests: 9/9. Next: the trace of blaze-query a_warm_miss_allocates_at_most_a_segment after round 7c, sent to query-unify.
